question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a purple ball, Bob has a pink ball, Claire has a brown ball, Dave has a black ball, Eve has a silver ball, Fred has a blue ball, and Gertrude has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Eve and Bob swap balls. Then, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Fred and Bob swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Finally, Eve and Gertrude swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) purple ball
(B) pink ball
(C) brown ball
(D) black ball
(E) silver ball
(F) blue ball
(G) gold ball
solution:
Ball colors in each row are listed for Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude, respectively.
Initial: purple, pink, brown, black, silver, blue, gold
1. Eve and Bob swap: purple, silver, brown, black, pink, blue, gold
2. Fred and Alice swap: blue, silver, brown, black, pink, purple, gold
3. Fred and Bob swap: blue, purple, brown, black, pink, silver, gold
4. Fred and Dave swap: blue, purple, brown, silver, pink, black, gold
5. Bob and Gertrude swap: blue, gold, brown, silver, pink, black, purple
6. Gertrude and Dave swap: blue, gold, brown, purple, pink, black, silver
7. Eve and Gertrude swap: blue, gold, brown, purple, silver, black, pink
Alice has the blue ball, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
